verdict.rationale: Canny can push feedback to Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana and sync statuses, and it can update idea statuses. That is an adjacent status-sync feature for feedback items, not a monitoring view of in-progress tasks. Nothing in the pack shows real-time task status, blockers, or last-update information.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch the real-time status of each in-progress task, including what it's blocked on and its last update
